| 325 | Tournament presets per admin. Migration 61: table tournament_presets (id, user_id, name, name_key, body_json, created_at, updated_at), unique (user_id, name_key). API (admins, each only their own): GET /tournament-presets (sorted by name), POST /tournament-presets with name (1 to 40 characters), body and replace (the series template TemplateBody without bots; server and profile may be empty), DELETE /tournament-presets/:id. At most 20 per admin (MAX_PRESETS), names unique per admin regardless of case: the same name answers 409 unless replace is set. The path is /tournament-presets instead of /tournaments/presets from the plan, so it cannot meet the route /tournaments/:id. The anonymized export drops the table (admins' own settings, Discord webhooks among them). Web: na-form-presets (components/form-presets.ts) above the form while it is not locked: a chip per preset with a short hint (kind, mode, size, parallel; core/presets.ts presetHint), apply on click, × deletes after asking (danger), Save as preset asks for the name in place (suggests the tournament's name; Enter saves, Escape cancels) and asks before replacing a preset of the same name. A chip is lit while the form still equals what it applied or saved. Applying keeps the name typed, the date and a series' schedule, falls back to an online server when the preset's server is gone and drops the season kinds when no season runs for a single tournament. Patch note 325 covers 324 and 325. | 327 | How it works for every Dream Team page (na-guide). Until now only the Dream Team had a help dialog (one for all, opened from the navigation and the hub); elsewhere explanations sat in fold-outs (na-help: trades rules, market legend, scouting note, mentors), in a details box (stamina on My team) or as long hints. New component na-guide (components/guide.ts): a pill button with ? in the page head (last item, at the right end; violet in the Dream Team, cyan elsewhere; only the ? below 640 px, 40 px high) with a dot until it was opened once in this browser (localStorage tourney.guide.<page>), and a dialog with one sentence, fact chips, three to five numbered steps and sections to unfold. The content is data (core/guides.ts: GUIDES with i18n keys; steps may link; a paragraph may need a param), texts guide.<page>.* in English and German, many sections reuse the texts that were already there (stamina, trade rules, market legend and price, loan, scouting, mentors, crafting, workshop, mod versions, league scoring and games, auto entry, graduation). Pages pass the numbers (rest price, trade fee and lock, index). A root service Guides opens a page's guide at a section from anywhere: Stamina on My team, The rules in detail on Trades, the legend link on the market, Talents and hidden traits and How mentors work in the academy are now links into the guide. Pages: hub (its centre opens the guide dt, no button), My team, league, packs, cups (also the cup table), market, trades, academy, club house, yearbook. The old help dialog (udt-help), the help button of the Dream Team navigation and na-help are gone; test guides.test.ts checks every key in both languages and the sizes. The initial bundle grows by about 16 kB (the texts are in the dictionary).
